area.title: Area
area.text: One part of a [[view tab]]. An area holds one [[view]] or [[generator]]. Split it to get more areas.

view.title: View
view.text: A way to show and arrange generators: [[clipview|Clipview]], [[cuelist|CueList]], [[patchview|Patchview]] or [[tabview|Tabview]]. A view fills an [[area]].

view tab.title: View tab
view tab.text: A tab of the [[top bar]]. Each one is a work area of its own, with its own [[layout]].

layout.title: Layout
layout.text: How a [[view tab]] is split into [[area|areas]], and what each one holds. Right-click the tab to save it as a [[preset]].

split.title: Split
split.text: Two or more [[area|areas]] side by side or one above the other. Drag the line between two of them to change their sizes.

preset.title: Preset
preset.text: A [[view]] or [[generator]] saved with its settings. An empty [[area]] offers the presets of the views, the presets of a generator are in its folder in the tab Assets.

generator.title: Generator
generator.text: A building block that makes or changes something: a shader, an oscillator, a mapper. It has a window of its own with its controls and a [[power button]].

link.title: Link
link.text: A connection from one control to another: the first one drives the second. Drag from a [[notch]] onto another control to make one. Its [[link type|type]] sets how the value is passed on.

notch.title: Notch
notch.text: The small handle at the edge of a control. Drag from it to [[link]] the control, click it for the [[options]] of the control.

cable view.title: Cable view
cable view.text: Draws every [[link]] whose two controls are on the screen as a cable. The link button in the bar of the [[timeline]] switches it.

show mode.title: Show mode
show mode.text: Locks the screen for performing: nothing can be linked, moved or closed by accident. Values, clips and MIDI keep working. The lock in the bar of the [[timeline]] switches it; hold the lock to leave.

top bar.title: Top bar
top bar.text: The bar at the top of the window: sidebar button, menu, settings, help, undo and redo, the [[view tab|view tabs]], the name of the [[project]] and the window buttons.

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.text: The panel at the left with the tabs Assets, Devices, Chat and MCP. The button at the left edge of the [[top bar]] shows or hides it. It holds the [[asset|assets]] and your devices.

project.title: Project
project.text: Everything you save under one name: your views and generators, the values of all controls, your [[link|links]] and [[midi mapping|MIDI mappings]]. New, open and save are in the menu of the [[top bar]].

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.text: The area at the bottom of the window. Its bar holds the tempo, the play position, Play and [[show mode]]. [[autoplay|Autoplay]] and every synced shader run on its [[beat|beats]].

beat.title: Beat
beat.text: One count of the tempo of the [[timeline]], 4 beats per bar. [[autoplay|Autoplay]] counts in beats.

clipview.title: Clipview
clipview.text: A [[view]] for playing live: a grid of [[clip|clips]] in [[layer|layers]] and [[column|columns]].

clip.title: Clip
clip.text: One cell of a [[clipview|Clipview]]. Drag an [[asset]] onto an empty cell to make one, click its picture to start it.

layer.title: Layer
layer.text: One row of a [[clipview|Clipview]]. Each layer lays its live [[clip]] over the layers below it. Layer 1 is the top row and gives the final picture.

column.title: Column
column.text: The [[clip|clips]] of a [[clipview|Clipview]] that stand one below the other. Its button in the top row starts every clip in it at once.

autoplay.title: Autoplay
autoplay.text: Starts the [[clip|clips]] of a [[layer]] one after the other: forwards, backwards or in random order. It counts the beats of the [[timeline]], so it waits while the timeline is stopped.

cuelist.title: CueList
cuelist.text: A [[view]] that shows [[clip|clips]] as lists of [[cue|cues]] with big buttons, one list per [[layer]]. Made for running a show.

cue.title: Cue
cue.text: One button of a [[cuelist|CueList]]: a [[clip]] that starts with a click. Drop an [[asset]] on the CueList to get one.

patchview.title: Patchview
patchview.text: A [[view]] with a free area: generators sit in their own windows anywhere, and their [[link|links]] are drawn.

tabview.title: Tabview
tabview.text: A [[view]] with tabs, each holding one view or [[generator]].

midi mapping.title: MIDI mapping
midi mapping.text: Ties a control to a fader, a knob or a pad of a MIDI controller, so the control follows it. Make one with [[midi learn|MIDI learn]]. It is saved with the [[project]].

midi learn.title: MIDI learn
midi learn.text: Learn mode for [[midi mapping|MIDI mappings]]: click the overlay of a control, then move a fader or hit a pad. The button is in the [[sidebar]], tab Devices, section MIDI.

asset.title: Asset
asset.text: Anything you can drag into a [[view]]: a [[generator]], a [[shader]], a view, a picture or a video. The assets are in the tab Assets of the [[sidebar]].

shader.title: Shader
shader.text: A [[generator]] that makes or changes a picture. It has an Out [[port]], and can send its picture to a display, to NDI or to Spout.

power button.title: Power button
power button.text: The button with the power sign in the header of a [[generator]]. Off: the generator stops and costs nothing. It is a control: it can be [[link|linked]] and mapped to MIDI.

options.title: Options
options.text: The small window of a control, opened by a click on a [[notch]]: its name and range, the [[link|links]] in and out, its [[midi mapping|MIDI mapping]] and its [[envelope]].

link type.title: Link type
link type.text: How a [[link]] passes the value on. Absolute: the raw value. Normalized: the place in the range of the sender, spread over the range of the receiver. Inverted: the same, upside down.

pure output.title: Pure output
pure output.text: A row that its [[generator]] writes every frame, for example the Beat of the audio analysis. It has only a right [[notch]]: [[link]] from it, not into it.

port.title: Port
port.text: Where a picture goes into a [[generator]] (In) or comes out of it (Out). [[link|Link]] an Out to an In like any two controls.

sender.title: Sender
sender.text: A control marked to be linked from often. Every other control lists the senders in its [[options]], so a [[link]] is made without dragging.

envelope.title: Envelope
envelope.text: A curve in the [[options]] of a slider that shapes the value it sends. With a sync, the [[timeline]] runs the control through its range on every [[beat]].

hold and drag.title: Hold and drag
hold and drag.text: Press on a row and hold still until its [[notch]] fills, then drag: a [[link]] starts from anywhere on the row. Made for touch screens.

header.title: Header of an area
header.text: The strip at the top of an [[area]] with its name and its buttons: split, maximize, more actions, close. Drag it to move the [[view]] to another area.

drop zone.title: Drop zone
drop zone.text: Where a drop lands in an [[area]]: an edge [[split|splits]] the area, the middle adds a tab. The zone shows while you drag.

undo.title: Undo
undo.text: Takes back the last change of the [[layout]] (Ctrl+Z); redo does it again (Ctrl+Y). Views move back as they are, with their [[link|links]].

live.title: Live
live.text: On air: the [[clip]] a [[layer]] shows right now has a green ring. The button Live of a [[clipview|Clipview]] locks its grid for playing.

transition.title: Transition
transition.text: How long a [[layer]] fades from one [[clip]] to the next, in seconds. 0 is a hard cut.

macro.title: Macro
macro.text: One of eight sliders of a [[clip]] that you [[link]] to its effect values. The macros of the [[layer]] then play whichever clip is [[live]].

stack.title: Stack
stack.text: The [[asset|assets]] a [[clip]] is made of, listed in the Layer window of a [[clipview|Clipview]]. Drop an asset on a clip to add it as an effect.

bpm.title: BPM
bpm.text: The tempo of the [[timeline]] in [[beat|beats]] per minute. Type it, tap it, or let the audio analysis or the CDJs set it.

video router.title: Video router
video router.text: Offers the picture of a [[shader]], a video or a receiver under a name, so other shaders and the mapping tools can pick it from a list instead of a [[link]].

fixture.title: Fixture
fixture.text: A lamp with its channels, described by a file. The lamps of a [[project]] are set up in the [[fixture setup]]; their channels are sliders in the tab Devices of the [[sidebar]] that can be [[link|linked]] and mapped.

art-net.title: Art-Net
art-net.text: DMX over the network, the way VibeVJ talks to lights. The nodes it finds are listed in the tab Devices of the [[sidebar]].

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.text: The text that shows when the mouse rests on something. A word shown as a link has a tooltip of its own; F1 opens the wiki at the part the tooltip is about.

help.title: Help
help.text: The wiki in a window of the program. The ? button of the [[top bar]] and F1 open it.

fixture setup.title: Fixture setup
fixture setup.text: Where the lamps of a [[project]] are set up: node, universe and address of each [[fixture|lamp]], where it hangs on the stage plan, and groups. Setup.menu in Fixtures of the tab Assets.

phaser.title: Phaser
phaser.text: Runs a wave over the lamps of a group, each lamp a bit later than the one before: wave, speed in beats, phase, width, wings.

led segment.title: Segment (LEDMapper)
led segment.text: One LED strip in the LEDMapper with its own number of LEDs: a line, a curve or a matrix drawn over the picture. The segments of a group follow one after the other on a node.
